scope: Finite AP3G IAR diagnostic. The self-presentability relation is stipulated as a new formal relation; ground identity and consciousness are not modeled or proven.
conditional_statement: If the IAR relation is warranted as the genuine-mode membership law and the aware-ground self-presentation/plenitude package is accepted, every one of the 16 gauge-inequivalent IAR modes is conditionally realised as a nonexclusive aspect. This test supplies neither warrant nor phenomenality.
restricted_conclusion: IAR is an explicit, nontrivial formal candidate for mode membership (domain, gauge quotient, inclusion/exclusion, boundedness, coexistence). Its new compatibility relation requires independent metaphysical or physical justification.
